name: aws2-s3
title: AWS S3 Storage Service
description: Store and retrieve objects from AWS S3 Storage Service.
label: cloud,file

properties.name: bucketNameOrArn
properties.description: Bucket name or ARN

properties.name: autoCreateBucket
properties.label: common
properties.description: Setting the autocreation of the S3 bucket bucketName. This will apply also in case of moveAfterRead option enabled, and it will create the destinationBucket if it doesn't exist already.

properties.name: delimiter
properties.description: The delimiter which is used in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ListObjectsRequest to only consume objects we are interested in.

properties.name: forcePathStyle
properties.description: Set whether the S3 client should use path-style URL instead of virtual-hosted-style

properties.name: ignoreBody
properties.label: common
properties.description: If it is true, the S3 Object Body will be ignored completely if it is set to false, the S3 Object will be put in the body. Setting this to true will override any behavior defined by includeBody option.

properties.name: overrideEndpoint
properties.description: Set the need for overriding the endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with the uriEndpointOverride option

properties.name: pojoRequest
properties.description: If we want to use a POJO request as body or not

properties.name: policy
properties.description: The policy for this queue to set in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3#setBucketPolicy() method.

properties.name: prefix
properties.description: The prefix which is used in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.ListObjectsRequest to only consume objects we are interested in.

properties.name: region
properties.description: The region in which the S3 client needs to work. When using this parameter, the configuration will expect the lowercase name of the region (for example, ap-east-1) You'll need to use the name Region.EU_WEST_1.id()

properties.name: uriEndpointOverride
properties.description: Set the overriding uri endpoint. This option needs to be used in combination with overrideEndpoint option

properties.name: customerAlgorithm
properties.label: common,advanced
properties.description: Define the customer algorithm to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

properties.name: customerKeyId
properties.label: common,advanced
properties.description: Define the id of the Customer key to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

properties.name: customerKeyMD5
properties.label: common,advanced
properties.description: Define the MD5 of Customer key to use in case CustomerKey is enabled

properties.name: deleteAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Delete objects from S3 after they have been retrieved. The deleting is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the object is not deleted. If this option is false, then the same objects will be retrieved over and over again in the polls. Therefore, you need to use the Idempotent Consumer EIP in the route to filter out duplicates. You can filter using the AWS2S3Constants#BUCKET_NAME and AWS2S3Constants#KEY headers, or only the AWS2S3Constants#KEY header.

properties.name: destinationBucket
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination bucket where an object must be moved when moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: destinationBucketPrefix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination bucket prefix to use when an object must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: destinationBucketSuffix
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Define the destination bucket suffix to use when an object must be moved, and moveAfterRead is set to true.

properties.name: doneFileName
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If provided, Camel will only consume files if a done file exists.

properties.name: fileName
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: To get the object from the bucket with the given file name

properties.name: includeBody
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If it is true, the S3Object exchange will be consumed and put into the body and closed. If false, the S3Object stream will be put raw into the body and the headers will be set with the S3 object metadata. This option is strongly related to the autocloseBody option. In case of setting includeBody to true because the S3Object stream will be consumed then it will also be closed, while in case of includeBody false then it will be up to the caller to close the S3Object stream. However, setting autocloseBody to true when includeBody is false it will schedule to close the S3Object stream automatically on exchange completion.

properties.name: includeFolders
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If it is true, the folders/directories will be consumed. If it is false, they will be ignored, and Exchanges will not be created for those

properties.name: maxConnections
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Set the maxConnections parameter in the S3 client configuration. This option is deprecated and has no effect. Use the httpClientBuilder option on the S3 client configuration to customize the HTTP client connection pool.

properties.name: maxMessagesPerPoll
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Gets the maximum number of messages as a limit to poll at each polling. Gets the maximum number of messages as a limit to poll at each polling. The default value is 10. Use 0 or a negative number to set it as unlimited.

properties.name: moveAfterRead
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Move objects from S3 bucket to a different bucket after they have been retrieved. To accomplish the operation, the destinationBucket option must be set. The copy bucket operation is only performed if the Exchange is committed. If a rollback occurs, the object is not moved.

properties.name: removePrefixOnMove
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: Remove the contents of the prefix configuration string from the new S3Object key before copying. For example, if prefix is set to 'demo/notify' and the destinationBucketPrefix is set to 'demo/archive', an S3Object with a key of 'demo/notify/example.txt' will be copied to 'demo/archive/example.txt', rather than the default behavior where the new key is 'demo/archive/demo/notify/example.txt'. Only applicable when moveAfterRead is true.

properties.name: sendEmptyMessageWhenIdle
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: If the polling consumer did not poll any files, you can enable this option to send an empty message (no body) instead.

properties.name: autocloseBody
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: If this option is true and includeBody is false, then the S3Object.close() method will be called on exchange completion. This option is strongly related to includeBody option. In case of setting includeBody to false and autocloseBody to false, it will be up to the caller to close the S3Object stream. Setting autocloseBody to true, will close the S3Object stream automatically.

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: inProgressRepository
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: A pluggable in-progress repository org.apache.camel.spi.IdempotentRepository. The in-progress repository is used to account the current in progress files being consumed. By default a memory based repository is used.

properties.name: pollStrategy
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: A pluggable org.apache.camel.PollingConsumerPollingStrategy allowing you to provide your custom implementation to control error handling usually occurred during the poll operation before an Exchange have been created and being routed in Camel.

properties.name: batchMessageNumber
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The number of messages composing a batch in streaming upload mode

properties.name: batchSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The batch size (in bytes) in streaming upload mode

properties.name: bufferSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The buffer size (in bytes) in streaming upload mode

properties.name: deleteAfterWrite
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Delete file object after the S3 file has been uploaded

properties.name: keyName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Setting the key name for an element in the bucket through endpoint parameter

properties.name: multiPartUpload
properties.label: producer
properties.description: If it is true, camel will upload the file with multipart format. The part size is decided by the partSize option. Camel will only do multipart uploads for files that are larger than the part-size thresholds. Files that are smaller will be uploaded in a single operation.

properties.name: namingStrategy
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The naming strategy to use in streaming upload mode

properties.name: operation
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The operation to do in case the user don't want to do only an upload

properties.name: partSize
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Set up the partSize which is used in multipart upload, the default size is 25 MB. The minimum size in AWS is 5 MB. Camel will only do multipart uploads for files that are larger than the part-size thresholds. Files that are smaller will be uploaded in a single operation.

properties.name: restartingPolicy
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The restarting policy to use in streaming upload mode

properties.name: storageClass
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The storage class to set in the com.amazonaws.services.s3.model.PutObjectRequest request.

properties.name: streamingUploadMode
properties.label: producer
properties.description: When stream mode is true, the upload to bucket will be done in streaming

properties.name: streamingUploadTimeout
properties.label: producer
properties.description: While streaming upload mode is true, this option set the timeout to complete upload

properties.name: timestampGroupingEnabled
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Enable timestamp-based grouping of messages into time windows for file creation. When enabled, messages are grouped by their timestamp header into time windows.

properties.name: timestampHeaderName
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The name of the message header containing the timestamp for grouping. Default is CamelMessageTimestamp.

properties.name: timestampWindowSizeMillis
properties.label: producer
properties.description: The size of the time window in milliseconds for timestamp-based grouping. Messages within the same time window will be written to the same file. Default is 300000 (5 minutes).

properties.name: awsKMSKeyId
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Define the id of KMS key to use in case KMS is enabled

properties.name: conditionalWritesEnabled
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Uploads the object only if the object key name does not already exist in the bucket specified.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: useAwsKMS
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Define if KMS must be used or not

properties.name: useCustomerKey
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Define if Customer Key must be used or not

properties.name: useSSES3
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Define if SSE S3 must be used or not

properties.name: amazonS3Client
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Reference to a com.amazonaws.services.s3.AmazonS3 in the registry.

properties.name: amazonS3Presigner
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: An S3 Presigner for Request, used mainly in createDownloadLink operation

properties.name: proxyHost
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy host when instantiating the SQS client

properties.name: proxyPort
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: Specify a proxy port to be used inside the client definition.

properties.name: proxyProtocol
properties.label: proxy
properties.description: To define a proxy protocol when instantiating the S3 client

properties.name: backoffErrorThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent error polls (failed due some error) that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffIdleThreshold
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The number of subsequent idle polls that should happen before the backoffMultipler should kick-in.

properties.name: backoffMultiplier
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To let the scheduled polling consumer backoff if there has been a number of subsequent idles/errors in a row. The multiplier is then the number of polls that will be skipped before the next actual attempt is happening again. When this option is in use then backoffIdleThreshold and/or backoffErrorThreshold must also be configured.

properties.name: delay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the next poll.

properties.name: greedy
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: If greedy is enabled, then the ScheduledPollConsumer will run immediately again, if the previous run polled 1 or more messages.

properties.name: initialDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Milliseconds before the first poll starts.

properties.name: repeatCount
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Specifies a maximum limit of number of fires. So if you set it to 1, the scheduler will only fire once. If you set it to 5, it will only fire five times. A value of zero or negative means fire forever.

properties.name: runLoggingLevel
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: The consumer logs a start/complete log line when it polls. This option allows you to configure the logging level for that.

properties.name: scheduledExecutorService
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Allows for configuring a custom/shared thread pool to use for the consumer. By default each consumer has its own single threaded thread pool.

properties.name: scheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To use a cron scheduler from either camel-spring or camel-quartz component. Use value spring or quartz for built in scheduler

properties.name: schedulerProperties
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: To configure additional properties when using a custom scheduler or any of the Quartz, Spring based scheduler. This is a multi-value option with prefix: scheduler.

properties.name: startScheduler
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Whether the scheduler should be auto started.

properties.name: timeUnit
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Time unit for initialDelay and delay options.

properties.name: useFixedDelay
properties.label: consumer,scheduler
properties.description: Controls if fixed delay or fixed rate is used. See ScheduledExecutorService in JDK for details.

properties.name: accessKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Access Key

properties.name: profileCredentialsName
properties.label: security
properties.description: If using a profile credentials provider, this parameter will set the profile name

properties.name: secretKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Secret Key

properties.name: sessionToken
properties.label: security
properties.description: Amazon AWS Session Token used when the user needs to assume an IAM role

properties.name: trustAllCertificates
properties.label: security
properties.description: If we want to trust all certificates in case of overriding the endpoint

properties.name: useDefaultCredentialsProvider
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a default credentials provider.

properties.name: useProfileCredentialsProvider
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to load credentials through a profile credentials provider.

properties.name: useSessionCredentials
properties.label: security
properties.description: Set whether the S3 client should expect to use Session Credentials. This is useful in a situation in which the user needs to assume an IAM role for doing operations in S3.
